title: On the Role of Attention Heads in Large Language Model Safety

layout.note: Two stacked bands tied by one long gold curly brace. The upper band is a left-to-right mechanism strip: a sketched attention block, its head column, the masked matrix, a big ablation arrow, the faded ablated matrix and the weight times value, FFN and output stack at the right. The lower band shows behaviour: before-ablation harmful and benign query rows with llamas and bubbles on the left, a Safety Head and scissors column in the centre, the after-ablation rows on the right.

lesson: Use a long brace to carry the one highlighted component from its zoomed-in mechanism down to its behavioural effect, and show the intervention with a faded copy of the ablated structure above and a mascot that reacts differently before and after below.
